# Ship
## When to use
Requested delivery only.
## Required context
Diff and review results.
## Preconditions
Irreversible actions need human approval unless already explicitly authorized.
## Procedure
Check proof and scope before commit, push, PR or deployment.
Activate `change-delivery` for detailed delivery safeguards.
## Tools
Authorized delivery tools.
## Rules
Respect explicit no-delivery requests.
## Verification
Confirm actual delivery state.
## Evidence
Results, identifiers and limits.
## Completion criteria
Only authorized actions occurred.
## Failure modes
Missing proof: report the blocker.
## References
[Delivery boundaries](references/playbook.md).


## Paved integration

Use the project-local Paved contract as the source of truth. Discover state with `node "<plugin root>/scripts/paved.mjs" status --json`, load only relevant `.paved/project/` context, and invoke verification with `node "<plugin root>/scripts/paved.mjs" verify --json`. `<plugin root>` is the installed Paved plugin directory, two directories above this SKILL.md. Always run the launcher from the repository being worked on, never from the plugin directory. Do not edit generated integration files or bypass Paved lifecycle and ownership checks.
